### levels automatic reference note (Plan 03-03-T5)

The levels_auto case (`mode=1`, percentiles 2/50/98) pins dt-side
ADOPTION only (DB op_params hex: 01000000 00000040 00004842 0000c442
+ 'params v. 2: version ok params ok'). The Lightamer-side reference
for the automatic chain is IN-TEST and SELF-CONSISTENT
(testLevelsAutomaticSelfConsistentParity): the GPU histogram →
percentile levels → LUT → apply, compared against a float64
evaluation of the SAME levels. A pre-generated per-pixel EXR
reference would bake in the float64 histogram binning, which
disagrees with the GPU's float32 bin assignment at ~1e-4 of pixels;
a single bin shift at a percentile crossing changes the GLOBAL LUT
(a shift the <1e-4 pixel gate cannot absorb). Gates instead:
histogram vs analytic (drift ≤8 counts, levels ±1 bin), parity
<1e-4 relative+absolute, ΔE p99 < 1.0. 256 bins per the plan (dt:
16384 — divergence #1); histogram recomputed per pipe run.

## dt-cli ↔ Lightamer colisa field mapping (Plan 03-03-T2)

dt blob `<fff` (little-endian pack of dt_iop_colisa_params_t v1,
hex-ASCII in XMP) ↔ Lightamer `ColisaModule.Params` (JSON):

| dt field (offset) | Lightamer field | note |
|---|---|---|
| contrast (0, f) | `contrast` | both ∈ [-1,1]; commit rescale +1 → [0,2] |
| brightness (4, f) | `brightness` | commit rescale ×2 → [-2,2]; gamma = 1/(1+b) if b≥0 else 1−b (colisa.c:220 — the plan text's 10^(−b) form does not exist in the source tree; recorded deviation) |
| saturation (8, f) | `saturation` | commit rescale +1 → [0,2] (0 = unchanged, NOT b&w) |

Pixel math (both sides): Rec2020→Lab (project LabRoundTrip constants;
dt: pixelpipe work-profile conversion), L = ctable[L/100] →
ltable[L/100] (NEAREST truncation lookups, power-law extrapolation
above 1.0), a,b × (saturation+1), Lab→Rec2020. Track-A references
are SYNTHESIZED (L017 route); dt pinned via the PFM probes above on
the uniform flats + XMP op_params adoption.

## dt-cli host finding (Plan 03-02, 2026-09-19)

darktable-cli (rebuilt dc58cf0ba1, Apple clang + libomp, macOS 27/arm64) emits
SPATIALLY CORRUPTED float output for spatially-varying images in ALL float
writers tried (EXR: per-channel-plane mislayout; PFM/TIFF: horizontal smear),
deterministic per input; uniform images (flat_NNev) export exactly. Exposure
on the ramp exports exactly through EXR (the 03-01 gate), temperature does
not. A no-OpenMP rebuild was attempted (USE_OPENMP=OFF): darktable-cli then
hangs at startup in dt_image_get_camera_id — unusable.
Consequences: temperature track-A references are SYNTHESIZED from the shared
semantic (canonical fixture × pinned gains, float64 — gen_fixtures.py refs);
dt-cli PFM probes on the uniform flats verify dt's per-pixel semantic
(temperature_r120_b080 on flat_0ev: (0.6, 0.5, 0.4) exact, 4e-8); the pinned
params adoption is verified via the library DB op_params hex + -d params log.
